rationale.usefulness: The documented gateway, deny-by-default policy and separate compute/inference accounting give agent builders a practical credential-management pattern. The proposed programming lab, app worker and transcript-processing workflows have concrete acceptance checks without claiming turnkey safety.
rationale.impact: This is a useful incremental infrastructure integration: it makes an existing hosted execution environment work with existing cloud inference through a centralized credential gateway. The archives do not establish a new AI capability, broad adoption, measured development gains or a substantial advance beyond this integration.
rationale.novelty: Keeping provider keys outside workers and enforcing gateway access policies are established engineering patterns. The distinctive contribution is their documented Ollama/Sprites integration and agent discovery, rather than a fundamentally new security or inference technique.
rationale.maturity: A release walkthrough, operational reference, error distinctions, access-policy controls and public resource prices support a concrete trial. Isolation, revocation behavior, checkpoint recovery, exact SDK compatibility and actual bills remain untested in this review.
rationale.openness: Public documentation and HTTP/OpenAI-compatible interfaces aid inspectability and migration at the client boundary. The gateway and persistent compute are hosted services requiring organization/provider accounts, while model-specific licenses and service behavior remain external dependencies.

concerns: No publication-blocking factual issue found. Credential isolation is correctly separated from permission to spend or expose data in authorized requests.
My independent impact rating is 4. The coordinator must apply the final mean-impact length gate; this substantive approval does not waive that gate.

Minor citation hygiene: the cost section links https://sprites.dev/ while the archived pricing source and report source record use https://fly.io/sprites/. The rate evidence itself matches the archive; using the exact captured destination would make provenance clearer.
